按作品位置选择短线，不把校园看成必须走完的大圈。: Choose a short route by artwork location instead of trying to circle the whole campus.
Stanford 最适合慢看的，不只是那张人人都拍的红瓦拱廊。先在 Main Q: Stanford rewards more than a quick photo of its tiled arcades. Watch light move through the Main Quad, then choose one work at Cantor worth another minute of attention. Free admission removes the pressure to see every gallery. Let each person choose a work and explain why it caught their eye: that is enough for a satisfying afternoon.
先核 Cantor 开放日与停车: Check Cantor’s opening days and parking first
建议 2.5–3.5 小时。Cantor 免费，校园公共室外段免门票；餐饮、往返: Allow 2.5–3.5 hours. Cantor and the public outdoor campus route are free; food, transport and any parking cost extra.
Cantor 当前周一/五 11:00–18:00，周四 11:00–20:00: Cantor currently opens Monday/Friday 11 a.m.–6 p.m., Thursday 11 a.m.–8 p.m., and Saturday/Sunday 10 a.m.–5 p.m. It closes Tuesday and Wednesday.
沿校园空间慢慢看艺术: Take an unhurried campus art walk
三站就够：建筑、展厅、户外艺术: Three stops: architecture, galleries and outdoor art
停留时长是编辑建议，不含往返交通；按现场开放和同行者体力调整。: Suggested stop durations are editorial estimates and exclude travel to and from the area. Adjust for closures and your group’s energy.
从指定通行路线看石拱廊和庭院，不进入正在上课或限制访客的空间。拍照时给自行车和校: View the arcades and courtyards from permitted routes. Do not enter teaching or restricted spaces; keep paths clear for cyclists and campus users.
按当天开放先选一至两个展厅，给每个人留“自己看”的时间。想听导览，就查该日安排，: Choose one or two open galleries and let everyone explore at their own pace. Check the daily schedule if you want a tour; general entry does not book a guided session.
第三站 · 馆外雕塑与返程: Third: outdoor sculpture and your return
用校园艺术地图挑馆外附近一站，看作品与树木、建筑的关系。之后回原来的停车点或车站: Use the public-art map to choose a nearby outdoor stop and notice its relationship to trees and buildings. Return to your original parking area or stop rather than crossing campus for another work.
先把“到 Stanford”变成“到哪一处入口”。Cantor 在 Museum: Choose a specific arrival point rather than simply navigating to Stanford. Cantor is near Museum Way and Lomita Drive, separate from the Main Quad. Use designated visitor parking and follow posted ParkMobile hours; a quiet weekend does not make every reserved space available. Cantor lists a southern ramp, accessible drop-off on Lomita Drive and loan wheelchairs. Shorten outdoor campus sections to suit your group.
带着适合自己的步行计划出发: Set out with a walk that suits your group
核对 Cantor 当天开馆时间，避免周二或周三只剩校园外景。: Check Cantor hours so a Tuesday or Wednesday visit does not unexpectedly become outdoors-only.
需要团体或校园导览时，确认独立预约已完成。: Confirm separate reservations for group visits or campus tours.
保存停车区域或返程站点；带水，给户外段留防晒。: Save your parking area or return stop; bring water and sun protection.
打开官方页面，按实际出行日期核对后再订票或出发。: Check the official page for your travel date before booking or setting out.
